title: Cookie Policy
description: How the Office of the Royal Society website uses cookies and browser storage

blocks.heading: Cookie Policy
blocks.lead: How the Office of the Royal Society website uses cookies and browser storage

blocks.heading: What are cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies and browser storage (Local Storage) are small pieces of data that a website saves on your device to remember your settings and make the site easier to use.
This website does not use cookies for tracking or advertising.

blocks.heading: Data this website stores in your browser
rows: Remembers your answer to the cookie consent bar
Remembers whether you chose grid or list view

blocks.heading: Content from third-party providers
paragraphs: Some pages include YouTube videos, a Google Calendar and links to Facebook. These providers may set their own cookies when you play or open their content, under their own policies.
Videos on this website play through youtube-nocookie.com, which does not set cookies until you press play.

blocks.heading: Managing cookies
paragraphs: Choose “Accept all” or “Necessary only” on the consent bar when you first visit, and clear stored data at any time in your browser settings.
